How gifting works

  1. Pick the flavour and box size — a single to try, or a box of 6 or 9 to share.
  2. Enter the recipient's address in the delivery field at checkout, and put your message in the notes box.
  3. Pay cash on delivery. If the box is going to someone else, tell us in the notes and we will arrange payment with you instead of the recipient — nobody wants to be handed a bill with their present.

Packaging

Every order is boxed with a greaseproof liner so the brownies arrive intact rather than stuck to the lid. Gift orders get a plain kraft box with no price anywhere on it.

A note on allergies

If you are sending to someone else, please check first. Nutty Delight contains walnuts and hazelnuts, and everything we bake shares a kitchen with nuts. The full breakdown is on the ingredients & allergens page.
